Great! 🚀 Let’s get started on your mental‑health journal app.  
Before we dive into code, I’ll ask a few quick questions so we design the safest, simplest version possible.

**1. Who will use this app?**  
  • Just you? A small group (friends, family)? A larger public audience?  
**2. What must it do on day one?**  
  Give the three most important features you want ready “out of the box”: e.g. write a daily entry, view past entries, secure login.  
**3. What information will it keep?**  
  Anything personal (names, email, photos, emotions, notes)?  
**4. Will people log in?**  
  Each user needs their own private space?  
**5. Is money involved?**  
  Will you charge for a subscription, or use any paid AI/API services?  
**6. What technology are you comfortable using?**  
  Even if you’re not a developer, choose a platform: Replit, Vercel + Next.js, a no‑code builder, etc.  
**7. Which accounts do you already have?**  
  E.g. a GitHub account, a Supabase or Firebase project, Stripe, etc.

Reply to the three most relevant ones, and I’ll draft a one‑screen plan that matches the risk level and gives us a clear next step.
